description: Replace hidden Action registration and permissive input parsing with manifest-backed built-ins, authoritative task/check input validation, structured error recovery, removed-Action tombstones, and a Runner-published Action catalog retained by the Server.

tasks.title: Deliver manifest-backed Actions with validated dispatch
tasks.spec: specs/action-manifests/spec.md#Every executable Action has one declarative definition, specs/action-manifests/spec.md#The manifest collection is the Action registry authority, specs/action-manifests/spec.md#Removed Actions are represented by catalog tombstones, specs/action-manifests/spec.md#Built-in Actions are fully manifest-backed, specs/action-manifests/spec.md#Platform and Action error codes have separate ownership, specs/action-input-validation/spec.md#Rendered Action input is validated before execution, specs/action-input-validation/spec.md#Unknown input fields fail explicitly, specs/action-input-validation/spec.md#Required inputs are enforced, specs/action-input-validation/spec.md#Input types use exact JSON kinds, specs/action-input-validation/spec.md#Defaults are applied centrally, specs/action-input-validation/spec.md#Input validation failures participate in task recovery
tasks.description: Implement finite-union Action definitions, immutable manifest/tombstone registry construction, deterministic catalog projection, shared input/result validation, and manifest-inferred `ValidatedActionContext` as one atomic Runner execution slice. Define all 17 built-ins from the audited inventory, replace bare registration and hard-coded removed-Action handling, switch task/check dispatch only after rendered input is validated/defaulted, and route structured Action-boundary failures through existing recovery without narrowing other Action capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Registry construction rejects non-canonical names, empty/duplicate/unsupported input kind sets, invalid or null static defaults, `working-directory` declarations, case-insensitive duplicates, executable/tombstone collisions, and reserved platform codes in business error catalogs

`mohist/opencode.prompt` declares canonical `types: ["string", "object"]`; definition inference, exact-kind validation, and catalog projection preserve string and object forms without an Action-specific exemption

All 17 Actions previously returned by `createDefaultRegistry()` are represented by manifests whose accepted keys, aliases, requiredness, static defaults, context fallbacks, public output fields, and business errors match the design inventory
Static and dynamic built-in failure branches are manifest-coupled or exhaustively tested so every emitted business error is declared and no existing recovery code is silently omitted
Case-insensitive `uses` resolution returns an executable definition, tombstone with guidance, or unknown; no bare `ActionRegistry.register(name, handler)` production or test path remains
Task and individual-check dispatch of `mohist/acp-agent` use tombstone rerun/replacement guidance while an unknown Action remains distinguishable

Every executable `uses` in shipped stage tasks, checks, approval-feedback tasks, and recovery tasks resolves to a built-in manifest; nested prompt-loader references are excluded, and ignored `mohist/create-github-pr.with.remote` is removed from the shipped profile

Unknown fields, omitted required inputs, explicit nulls, and exact-kind mismatches fail before Action execution with `invalid-input` naming the field, accepted kinds, and actual kind; no string/number/boolean coercion occurs
Omitted static defaults are cloned into validated input, valid explicit values win, invalid explicit values are not defaulted, and `working-directory` remains engine-owned

Valid tasks/checks invoke definitions exactly once through manifest-inferred `ValidatedActionContext`; broad runtime/Server/Variable context, rawWith, conditional semantics, dynamic defaults, implicit fallbacks, and name-based OpenCode promise projection remain available
Task `invalid-input`, `unexpected-error`, and declared business errors enter normal recovery matching with original structured context

Undeclared business codes, thrown exceptions, and malformed task results normalize to recoverable `unexpected-error`; malformed/undeclared/thrown check results retain row-level `unexpected-error` with aggregate `check-failed`, while invalid successful check output retains aggregate `unexpected-error`
The deterministic catalog matches the specified arrays/order, contains finite input kinds, public output field names, business errors, and tombstones, and excludes execution functions/private output
Existing built-in and custom-profile regressions pass for aliases, context-backed omission, rawWith propagation, outputs, error codes, recovery, and the only intended generic compatibility breaks
The existing built-in Workflow Profile Server specs pass after the ignored `remote` field is removed

`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm run test:ci -w packages/runner`, and the relevant Server test suite via `npm test` pass; new coverage introduces no real external dependency or wall-clock wait
tasks.output: Manifest/catalog, registry, input/result validation, and audited built-in definitions under packages/runner/src/actions/; atomic WorkExecutor/check integration through ValidatedActionContext; profile cleanup; migrated test definitions; and inventory/dispatch/recovery regression coverage.
tasks.notes: Registry resolution, input validation, typed invocation, and all built-in manifests are intentionally one task because separating them creates an unvalidated or cast-based execution contract. Validation remains top-level only; nested/conditional/context semantics stay with each Action. Tests consume embedded/generated or in-memory profile data, never workflow YAML from the host filesystem.

tasks.title: Publish and retain the Runner Action catalog
tasks.spec: specs/action-manifests/spec.md#Runner registration publishes the serializable Action catalog
tasks.description: Extend Runner registration state and the Server Runner published-language DTOs with the typed manifest-derived Action catalog. Make `RunnerHost` publish the catalog from the same validated registry instance used by `WorkExecutor` on registration and heartbeat repair, and retain the latest catalog through `RunnerInfo`, persistent last-known Runner state, and online registry mirroring without adding Profile validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Initial Runner registration and heartbeat repair send the deterministic catalog from the exact registry instance used for local Action resolution and validated invocation

The wire catalog matches the specified typed array schema and ordering, including canonical finite `types` arrays, required/default metadata, public output field declarations, business errors, and tombstone guidance
Typed TypeScript and C# catalog DTOs serialize and bind the same JSON shape; only the generic static-default leaf uses a generic JSON value
Execution functions, inferred TypeScript-only values, and implementation-private output are absent from the wire catalog

RunnerInfo and RunnerWorksState.LastKnownInfo retain the latest catalog across heartbeat repair, registry re-registration, and grain reactivation; a missing pre-registration catalog remains readable until the Runner reports one
Server receipt of a catalog does not reject or otherwise validate Workflow Profile saves in this task
Runner host tests assert register and heartbeat payloads; Server API/grain specs assert binding, ordering, and persistence using in-memory infrastructure

`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm run test:ci -w packages/runner`, and the relevant Server test suite via `npm test` pass; new coverage introduces no real external dependency or wall-clock wait
tasks.output: Action catalog fields in packages/runner registration/host code, typed Server API and Orleans Runner records, retained catalog state, and Runner/Server registration persistence tests.
tasks.notes: Do not add catalog digests, a second catalog endpoint, multi-Runner consensus, Profile save-time consumption, or Web/CLI exposure.
